title: Spikers' Turf: Cabstars outlast 3B in 5-set duel for second straight win
summary: AEP-Cabstars claimed its second consecutive victory in grueling fashion on Sunday, outlasting 3B in a five-set war at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
